questions.q: A force of 30 N acts at a perpendicular distance of 40 cm from a pivot. What is the moment of the force?
questions.why: Moment = F × d = 30 × 0.40 m = 12 N m (convert cm to m).

questions.q: A uniform beam is pivoted at its centre. A 6.0 N weight hangs 50 cm left of the pivot. What weight 20 cm right of the pivot balances it?
questions.why: Clockwise moment = anticlockwise moment: W × 20 = 6.0 × 50, so W = 15 N.

questions.q: Which change makes a table lamp most stable?
options: lower centre of gravity and wider base
higher centre of gravity and wider base
lower centre of gravity and narrower base
higher centre of gravity and narrower base
questions.why: A low centre of gravity and wide base mean it must tilt further before its weight acts outside the base.

questions.q: A crate weighing 600 N rests on a base of area 0.030 m². Calculate the pressure it exerts on the floor.
